data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue and pilot
data.body:
Hi,

Your June 30, 2026 13F shows positions in TRC and BRT.

TRC reported Q2 2026 revenue of $14.3M versus $8.3M a year earlier (+71.7% y/y), according to its SEC filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/96869/000162828026054146/0001628280-26-054146-index.htm).

I publish Local Ledger from public records only, never issuer-paid. May I send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot?

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
